reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for intravenous hydration therapy when 
• 
Reported using an approved ICD-10-CM diagnosis code as indicated in this policy 
• 
Reported infusion fluid is for 501 ml or more 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
Reported without an approved ICD-10-CM diagnosis code as indicated in this policy 
• 
Reported infusion fluid is 500 ml or less 
 
Individual claim lines reporting intravenous fluid HCPCS codes will be denied as not separately 
reported. 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT code(s), HCPCS 
Level II codes and ICD-10-CM codes reported.
